curation.reason: Add original reviewed representative vehicle schematics for exact known configurations. Data and art only; no source fact, lifecycle, role, origin, geography or retained asset correction.

features: Two 2.25 m liquid boosters retained from Long March 8 and new 3.35 m hydrogen/oxygen upper stage.
Large 5.2 m payload fairing is a documented Long March 8A distinguishing exterior feature.
coverage.limitations: Original source-dated representative schematic, not an engineering reconstruction, launch photograph, exact paintwork or mission-specific fairing/recovery choice. Published overall/core dimensions set aspect ratio where stated. Fairing lengths, collar/stage stations and unpublished dimensions are illustrative inspected-image proportions; they are not new catalog facts. Side boosters show total count in a flattened informational view. No logos, manufacturer graphics or photographs are redistributed. Exact configuration labels, provider facts, operator/manufacturer/origin/site roles and unknown values are preserved.
